def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
    idx = 0
    H = int(data[idx].strip()); idx += 1

        header += [''] * (H - len(header))
    N = int(data[idx].strip()); idx += 1
    rows = []

        idx += 1

        else:

        if len(vals) < H:
            vals = vals + [''] * (H - len(vals))

    out_lines = []

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out_lines) + '\n')

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
    nums_line = data[0] if len(data) > 0 else ''
    k_line = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
